questions.prompt: In Denver's 2023 championship playoff run, how many triple-doubles did Nikola Jokić record?
questions.note: 10 triple-doubles, an extraordinary number in one postseason.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Most triple-doubles in the same postseason (10): Denver Nuggets, 2022–23

funFacts.text: He put up 34 points, 21 rebounds and 14 assists in the West finals opener.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jokić posted a triple-double with 34 points, 21 rebounds, and 14 assists

funFacts.text: His eighth playoff triple-double passed Wilt Chamberlain's mark.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: eighth of the playoffs breaking Chamberlain's 1967 NBA record

funFacts.text: He won the Western Conference Finals MVP award.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jokić was awarded his first NBA Conference Finals Most Valuable Player Award
